intro.label: OUR EXPERTISE / SOCIAL MEDIA MARKETING
intro.heading: Social media marketing.
intro.description: Social media marketing services for businesses that need a consistent, practical content plan. We discuss your audience, brand voice, selected platforms, and available assets before agreeing deliverables.

offers.title: Platform & content strategy
offers.description: Plan content themes and a calendar for an agreed mix of Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn. Choose platforms based on your audience rather than publishing the same content everywhere.

offers.title: Post design & captions
offers.description: Prepare branded designs, captions and hashtag research for review. Agree who supplies footage or photography, who approves content and who publishes the finished posts.

offers.title: Reporting & next steps
offers.description: Review monthly platform analytics and content performance within the agreed scope. Use the report to decide what to adjust next; follower counts, reach and leads are not guaranteed.

items.planning: Share your profiles, audience, brand guidelines and available footage. Agree the platform mix, post quantities, approval workflow, publishing and comment-handling responsibilities. Paid ad management is not assumed as part of content planning.
detailsDescription: Plan content for the platforms your audience uses.
Agree creative work, approvals and reporting responsibilities.

items.title: Search Engine Optimization
items.short: Search engine optimization services covering keyword research, on-page improvements, technical reviews, and content planning. We identify priorities from your website, audience, and current search visibility.
items.description: Search engine optimization services covering keyword research, on-page improvements, technical reviews, and content planning. We identify priorities from your website, audience, and current search visibility.

intro.label: OUR EXPERTISE / SEARCH ENGINE OPTIMIZATION
intro.heading: SEO services.
intro.description: Search engine optimization services covering keyword research, on-page improvements, technical reviews, and content planning. We identify priorities from your website, audience, and current search visibility.

offers.title: Keyword research & page mapping
offers.description: Map relevant search queries and their intent to useful pages. The agreed research identifies page topics and content gaps; search volume or competition figures require suitable tools and market-specific evidence.

offers.title: On-page & technical SEO
offers.description: A scoped audit identifies affected pages, technical issues and recommended priorities. Review metadata, internal links, crawlability and mobile performance. Implementation responsibilities are agreed separately from the recommendations.

offers.title: Content planning & reporting
offers.description: Plan content around customer questions and review available Search Console data. Reporting distinguishes completed changes from observed search performance, without promising specific rankings or traffic.

items.planning: Share your website, priority services, markets and available Search Console access. Agree which findings we will implement, which require your developer or content team, and how changes and search performance will be reported. Rankings and traffic cannot be guaranteed.
detailsDescription: Understand the issues affecting your website.
Separate audit recommendations from agreed implementation.
